title: The Forehead Test That Reveals Your True Personality

vo.en: Draw a letter Q on your forehead.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's index finger pointing directly toward the camera lens in a stylized, high-contrast studio setting.

vo.en: Use your index finger. Trace it fast and don't think, just let your hand move naturally.

visual.description: A rapid time-lapse of a busy city intersection from a bird's eye view with blurred motion.

vo.en: Now, focus on the tail. Did you point it toward your left eye or your right?

visual.description: A macro shot of an antique brass compass with the needle spinning and settling on a direction.

vo.en: Stop, because this reveals a creepy secret about how your brain is actually wired.

visual.description: A futuristic blue digital animation of a human brain with glowing neural pathways pulsating with light.

vo.en: If the tail points right, you’re an authentic soul who doesn't care about others' opinions.

visual.description: A man standing alone on a rugged mountain peak overlooking a vast, misty forest at dawn.

vo.en: If it points left, you’re a social chameleon—an expert at reading people and mirroring them.

visual.description: A macro close-up of a lizard's eye rotating independently with high detail of the scales.

vo.en: You possess the rare power to adapt your personality to control any social situation you're in.

visual.description: A man in a sharp suit adjusting his silver cufflinks in a dark, atmospheric office environment.
